scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts tests playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.tools.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts .prettierrc.json README.md "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html,json}" "packages/**/*.{ts,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.ts"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.tools.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts .prettierrc.json README.md "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html,json}" "packages/**/*.{ts,json}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.ts"
